Panda & Tweet

A big, smiling panda with a little bird perched on its head, singing a song of musical notes. Drawn in pencil by Nafas Elizabeth Pattrick, for Nafas's Face Parade, and hung as one big drawing across the wall — the soft graphite and paper grain are part of the print. sized to your wall's measurements on Smooth Matt.
